2607.22928.title: Design Theater: Evaluating the Gap Between User-Facing Design Reasoning and Implementation in Generative UI Tools
2607.22928.paper_summary: Generative UI tools promise to democratize UI design by turning natural language descriptions into complete interfaces. Alongside the interface, these tools generate user-facing design rationales that explain their layout, accessibility, and design choices. However, it remains unclear whether these stated rationales are actually reflected in the interfaces they produce. We call this disconnect ``Design Theater'': plausible and confident design rationales that have little relationship to the actual implementation. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a benchmark and three metrics for measuring Design Theater. The benchmark includes 24 UI generation tasks spanning structural, styling, and functional design requirements. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 120 interfaces created by five generative UI tools. On average, over 25\% of user-facing design rationales are not implemented in the generated interface, and the implementation failure increases to 34\% for functional requirements. Tools recognize roughly half of the UX principles embedded in prompts (mean = 0.54), with four of five tools implementing 6\% or fewer functional principles. We also measure interface similarity across tools and find convergence in visual appearance and layout organization, with greater variation in color choices. Overall, we contribute: 1) the concept of Design Theater; 2) a benchmark with metrics for assessing whether the stated reasoning of generative UI tools is reflected in their implementations; 3) and findings from a systematic evaluation of these tools. We discuss what these findings mean for the design and evaluation of generative UI tools.
2607.22928.paper_summary_zh: 生成式 UI 工具承諾通過將自然語言描述轉化為完整的介面來實現 UI 設計的民主化。這些工具除了生成介面外，還會生成用戶面向的設計理由，解釋其佈局、可及性和設計選擇。然而，尚不清楚這些所述的理由是否實際反映在它們所產生的介面中。我們將這種脫節稱為「設計劇場」：看似合理且自信的設計理由與實際實現之間幾乎沒有關係。為了研究這一現象，我們引入了一個基準和三個衡量設計劇場的指標。該基準包括 24 個 UI 生成任務，涵蓋結構、樣式和功能設計要求。利用這個基準，我們評估了五個生成式 UI 工具創建的 120 個介面。平均而言，超過 25\% 的用戶面向設計理由未在生成的介面中實現，而對於功能要求，實現失敗的比例增加到 34\%。這些工具大約識別了嵌入提示中的一半 UX 原則（平均 = 0.54），其中五個工具中有四個實現了 6\% 或更少的功能原則。我們還測量了不同工具之間的介面相似性，發現視覺外觀和佈局組織上存在趨同，而顏色選擇則變化更大。總體而言，我們的貢獻包括：1）設計劇場的概念；2）一個基準及其指標，用於評估生成式 UI 工具所述的推理是否反映在其實現中；3）以及對這些工具的系統評估結果。我們討論這些發現對生成式 UI 工具的設計和評估意味著什麼。
